approval_context: Owner requested import of all existing Virtual Life character and animation sources into a browsable preview database. The approved change is portability of OPTIONAL reference comparison crops; individual character art and motion poses are unchanged and not newly approved.
reusable_insights: Do not make native sprite and animation builds depend on non-versioned, absolute paths to screenshots from a different workstation. Missing reference photos may be skipped only for optional comparison/contact artwork, preserving original rendered pixels.
promotion_rationale: Per-generator conditional guards are intentionally local to historical optional reference comparison blocks. The actual native pixel renderer and visual pose system remain unchanged; no shared rendering abstraction is necessary.
compatibility: Same character geometry, colors and animations; only optional historical comparison images are omitted when the private files cannot be found.
limitations: Asset previews remain unintegrated into live game; older reference screenshots are not distributed with public repository.
